rounds.question: Where does Todd change the link, and how much of the dialog moves when he does?
rounds.note: v01 is the pencil design from the chat. v00 is today's dialog.

variants.name: Current share dialog
variants.idea: The share dialog as it ships. The link can be copied and opened, not changed.

variants.name: Pencil on the link
variants.axis: edit in place behind a pencil
variants.idea: A pencil next to the copy icon turns the link row into a field with Save and Cancel. Nothing else in the dialog moves.
variants.cost: The pencil is easy to miss
variants.why: The smallest change that works. One icon, and the row it edits is the row that shows the link.

variants.name: The link is the field
variants.axis: no edit mode, the ending is always a field
variants.idea: The link row is a field from the start. clarity.video/ sits in front and opens the page, the ending is typed in place. Save and the status line show up only while the typed ending differs from the saved one.
variants.cost: Opening the page hides behind the prefix, and the row keeps an empty line under it so nothing jumps

variants.name: Change link popover
variants.axis: a layer instead of an in-place swap
variants.idea: A Change button in the link row opens a small popover under it with the field, the status line, Cancel and Save. The dialog under it never moves.
variants.cost: A popover on a dialog is one more layer, and it covers the rows below while open

variants.name: A step in the dialog
variants.axis: a second view inside the same dialog
variants.idea: A pencil opens Change link in the same dialog, with a full-width field and Save at the bottom.
variants.cost: Changing the link takes another step and hides the sharing controls.
